exposure: Aquaporin 3 (AQP3) mRNA expression in placenta and fetal membranes
AQP3 protein expression in placenta and fetal membranes
Adiponectin (ADP) level in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (case group) and 60 normal pregnant women in the same gestation period (control group).
finding: The relative expression of AQP3 mRNA and AQP3 protein in placenta tissue was significantly lower in the severe preeclampsia group, while it was significantly higher in fetal membranes, and the level of ADP in umbilical cord blood of neonates was remarkably increased in the severe preeclampsia group.
